description: Supporting data for “Continuous Relaxation–Based Flow Optimization in Water Distribution Networks is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Yoshihiro Shibuo. Numerical supporting data underlying Figures 1–5 and the principal quantitative findings of the related article. The package provides the shared 20 × 20 network, edge- and node-level results for symmetric, perturbed-initialization, and low-cost-corridor scenarios, formal optimization histories, confirmed settings, the corridor definition, and integrity metadata. Costs are total edge costs including prescribed base cost. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 173016 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
